SorafsReputationSnapshotIdHexV1.description: Exact non-zero 16-byte reputation snapshot identifier as lowercase hexadecimal without a prefix.

data.description: Canonical positive decimal count of events no longer retained.

SorafsReputationWeightsV1.description: Canonical V1 weights. The seven basis-point fields sum to exactly 10,000.

StateFinalityResponse.description: Exact first-release ledger state evidence. Every field is bound to the same State-committed block and cryptographically verified durable Sumeragi-v2 finality artifact.

block_hash.description: Canonical block-header hash matched to committed State and durable Kura evidence.

block_header.description: Canonical block header authenticated by the finality artifact.

finality_artifact.description: Exact current Sumeragi-v2 finality artifact verified by Kura.

payload_hex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal canonical framed instruction bytes.

SumeragiAutonomousLaneExecution.description: Bounded autonomous-lane durability evidence. Optional values may be omitted or null; after normalization proposal_hash and descriptor_hash form an exact pair. ReservationsDurable has no authenticated proposal view, finalized identity, executable payload, source bundle, merge entry, or carrier and requires equal reservation/transaction counts. Later non-conflict stages require the finalized identity pair and may carry an authenticated proposal view when the durable payload supplies one. Rows are strictly ordered by lane_id, dataspace_id, lane_incarnation, lane_block_height, lane_block_view, proposal_height, and proposal_identity_hash.

alias.description: Exact alias lookup key; the server enforces at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

SumeragiV2BlockSubject.description: Exact parent/block/payload subject. parent_block_hash is null only for genesis.

SumeragiV2BlsProof.description: Exact 96-byte BLS-normal proof/signature in Norito JSON's byte-array representation.

SumeragiV2BlsValidatorId.description: Canonical bare multihash string for a 48-byte BLS12-381 G1 (BLS-normal) validator public key.

SumeragiV2Bytes32.description: Exact 32-byte value in Norito JSON's canonical uppercase hexadecimal representation.

signers.description: Strictly increasing indices into the frozen roster.

SumeragiV2ConsensusMode.description: Adjacent-tag Norito JSON representation of the unit-variant Sumeragi-v2 consensus mode.

SumeragiV2DualQuorum.description: Canonical 2f+1 equal-vote quorum derived from a bounded 3f+1 roster.

SumeragiV2ExecutionCommitment.description: Mandatory deterministic execution result authenticated by every Prepare/Commit vote and quorum certificate. The top-up root slot is required and is null exactly when topup_anchor_count is zero. The lane-finality manifest slot is required and is null exactly when the block emits no lane-finality statements. Native AMX application manifest version/root/count are mandatory; version is 1, count is bounded to 1,024, and count is zero exactly for the canonical empty root. merge_carrier is mandatory and is null for an ordinary block or an exact V1 merge-ledger entry commitment. executed_block_wire_len is the non-zero exact byte length paired with executed_block_wire_hash.

SumeragiV2FinalityArtifact.description: Exact immutable finality sidecar persisted by the Sumeragi-v2 apply path, including the complete cryptographic material needed after mutable validator records rotate.

validator_set_pops.description: Durable BLS proofs of possession aligned one-for-one with height_context.roster.

SumeragiV2FinalizedNextEpochSnapshot.description: Complete parent-CommitQC-authenticated transition into the next epoch, including its end height and immutable validator PoPs.

validator_set_pops.description: Parent-authenticated BLS proofs of possession aligned one-for-one with the next roster.

SumeragiV2Fixed32ByteArray.description: Exact 32-byte value using the historical fixed-bytes Norito JSON adapter.

SumeragiV2GlobalPhase.description: Adjacent-tag Norito JSON representation of a global Sumeragi-v2 phase. Finality artifacts require commit.

SumeragiV2HeightContext.description: Complete immutable Sumeragi-v2 context. next_epoch_snapshot is non-null exactly at an epoch-ending height; parent_commit_qc is null only at height one or an authenticated snapshot-bootstrap boundary.

roster.description: Canonical ordered voting roster; observers are excluded and validator identities must be unique.

SumeragiV2HeightContextId.description: Single-field tuple struct containing the typed hash of the complete immutable height context.

SumeragiV2LaneFinalityManifestCommitment.description: Exact root and non-zero leaf count of the canonical lane-finality statement tree.

SumeragiV2MergeCarrierCommitment.description: Exact first-release merge-ledger entry identity authenticated by global finality.

SumeragiV2PayloadEncoding.description: Adjacent-tag Norito JSON representation of the unit-variant v2 payload encoding.

signers.description: Strictly increasing indices into the frozen roster.

SumeragiV2SnapshotBootstrapAnchor.description: Audited snapshot boundary that binds the first post-snapshot height context to the exact restored ledger geometry and state.

bytes_b64.description: Canonical standard-base64 encoding of 1 byte through 8 MiB of proof bytes for this compact response DTO.

overlay.description: Ordered canonical InstructionBox JSON values, bounded by the live transaction instruction limit.

Fetch content bundle bytes (path captures the remaining path segments). Canonical request-authentication headers are optional for public bundles. Role- and sponsor-gated bundles require either the complete account/signature/timestamp/nonce proof set or a canonical witness. Public responses may use the manifest's configured public cache policy; role- and sponsor-gated responses always return `Cache-Control: private, no-store` and vary over all canonical authentication headers. Existing protected bundles authenticate and authorize before file lookup: absent or invalid proof returns 401, authorization mismatch returns 403, and a missing file returns 404 only after successful authorization. Unknown or expired bundles also return 404. The Torii origin is a byte-delivery boundary, not a web-hosting origin: safe inert media retain their type, while active, unknown, or invalid media types are returned as `application/octet-stream` attachments. Every successful response sends `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and a restrictive sandbox Content Security Policy without changing byte or range semantics.

Cache headers are selected from the bundle manifest: public bundles may use their configured public policy, while role- and sponsor-gated bundles are private and non-storable. get.description: Return a bounded exact-cursor projection of canonical Norito, Ed25519-signed, globally sequenced and hash-chained payload-free receipts from one exact signed checkpoint. The only accepted genesis query wire is expected_checkpoint_digest_hex then limit, in that order. A continuation inserts after_sequence then after_receipt_digest_hex between those fields. Percent/plus aliases, reordered fields, duplicate or empty fields, omitted explicit limits, and non-canonical decimal or lowercase hexadecimal values are rejected. after_sequence and after_receipt_digest_hex must be supplied together and match the exact retained signed receipt; sequence-only or digest-only continuation is rejected. A checkpoint change returns 409 rather than silently repaginating. The response returns the signed checkpoint_anchor with authoritative store generation/predecessor pins, its exact signed compaction_archive_head, digest-bound page_limit, predecessor and next_cursor exact pairs, canonical projection_norito_b64, projection_digest_hex, has_more, and receipts; it never emits a sequence-only continuation. X-Iroha canonical authentication and the explicit sorafs_evidence_auditor or sorafs_legal_reviewer role are required; operator role alone is insufficient.

post.description: Submit one caller-signed external transaction containing exactly one ordinary Kagemusha V4 release-lifecycle instruction, no proof attachments, and the exact distinct governance-member signatures required by the native lifecycle admission policy. Prefer: return=minimal is forbidden. Torii returns 202 only after an authenticated exact f+1 coordinator certificate proves durable admission, then emits a signed TransactionSubmissionReceipt for the unchanged entrypoint and signed-transaction hashes. High-assurance clients must require singleton identity headers, canonical receipt bytes, and the configured ingress receipt signer; a transport failure or any non-202 response does not prove non-admission and must be reconciled by the exact hashes before replacement.

requestBody.description: The exact versioned SignedTransaction bytes authorized by the lifecycle signers. Production high-assurance submission uses canonical Norito without rebuilding or re-signing the transaction.

202.description: The exact transaction was durably admitted by an authenticated f+1 coordinator certificate. The receipt is signed by the configured ingress receipt key and binds both mandatory identity headers; this response never carries x-iroha-reject-code.

x-iroha-entrypoint-hash.description: Mandatory singleton lowercase hexadecimal hash of the admitted external transaction entrypoint.

x-iroha-signed-transaction-hash.description: Mandatory singleton lowercase hexadecimal hash of the unchanged caller-signed transaction wire.

400.description: The signed transaction is malformed, expired, not the exact ordinary V4 lifecycle shape, fails cryptographic admission, or requests a minimal response.

x-iroha-reject-code.description: Exact lifecycle-scope or signed-transaction admission code when available; framing and body-read failures sharing HTTP 400 may omit the header.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Authentication challenge for the Torii API-token scheme.

403.description: The authority is not registered or a governance, lane-compliance, or confidentiality policy rejected admission.

x-iroha-reject-code.description: Exact transaction-queue authorization or policy rejection code.

406.description: Neither application/json nor application/x-norito is acceptable; the deterministic response_not_acceptable error uses application/json because no requested representation was selected.

409.description: The exact transaction is already committed or queued, or its lifecycle durability binding conflicts with current authoritative routing state. Reconcile the existing exact hash before any replacement.

x-iroha-reject-code.description: Exact duplicate or lifecycle durability-binding conflict code.

413.description: The request body exceeds the configured transaction ingress limit; the lifecycle handler did not run.

415.description: The request content type is missing or unsupported.

422.description: The exact transaction cannot satisfy the Nexus fee-admission bound.

x-iroha-reject-code.description: Exact Nexus fee-admission rejection code.

429.description: The request or transaction queue is rate- or capacity-limited before durable admission.

Retry-After.description: Whole-second retry delay when supplied by canonical queue backpressure.

x-iroha-reject-code.description: Exact queue backpressure code when the failure originated in canonical transaction admission; other ingress limits may omit the header.

500.description: Torii failed internally before it could produce a trustworthy lifecycle admission result.

502.description: An authenticated authoritative peer returned an invalid lifecycle durability response; admission is not acknowledged.

503.description: Authenticated peer transport, routing, ingress compute, queue durability, or the signed public receipt is unavailable. PRTRY:QUEUE_PLAN_JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE means the journal definitely did not durably admit the transaction. PRTRY:QUEUE_PLAN_JOURNAL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN means admission may already have occurred: reconcile the exact hashes before retrying and do not create a replacement transaction until resolved. Only that outcome-unknown response carries singleton x-iroha-entrypoint-hash and x-iroha-signed-transaction-hash headers plus the same exact values in ErrorEnvelope.details.entrypoint_hash and ErrorEnvelope.details.tx_hash; it does not fabricate queue-pressure details or headers.

x-iroha-entrypoint-hash.description: Present exactly once only for PRTRY:QUEUE_PLAN_JOURNAL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; the exact external transaction-entrypoint hash also carried in ErrorEnvelope.details.entrypoint_hash.

x-iroha-reject-code.description: Exact availability or durability result when known, including route_unavailable, kagemusha_lifecycle_transport_unavailable, transaction_ingress_compute_saturated, PRTRY:QUEUE_PLAN_JOURNAL_UNAVAILABLE, or PRTRY:QUEUE_PLAN_JOURNAL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN. Infrastructure failures sharing HTTP 503 may omit it.

x-iroha-signed-transaction-hash.description: Present exactly once only for PRTRY:QUEUE_PLAN_JOURNAL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; the exact unchanged lifecycle SignedTransaction hash also carried in ErrorEnvelope.details.tx_hash.

504.description: The authoritative peer flow timed out; remote admission may be ambiguous and must be reconciled by exact hash.

The process-local admission registry retains only fixed-size canonical request bindings, shares configured count/byte capacity with in-flight reservations, never capacity-evicts an unexpired binding, and prunes accepted bindings 24 hours after signed authorization expiry. post.description: Evaluate the validation-fee base policy and Hijiri global/account-risk inputs from one committed-state snapshot for the checked successor execution height. The requested account must exactly equal the authenticated canonical-account principal or name a live multisig controller for which that principal is a direct signatory. Membership and the selected account-risk record are read from the same snapshot. The response echoes that account and the bounded transfer count, exposes the exact aggregate base and once-rounded adjusted fee, and carries the composite hash required by signed admission. This is an evaluated projection, not an independently witness-verified proof; later state changes can make it stale and admission will reject a mismatched binding.
